repair_rules: PlayerUsed{slot} <= 0: write PlayerUsed0 = 10001 and PlayerUsed1 = 10002, then read again (§2.3b).
PlayerUnlocked{ship} with ship < 10003 reads true without roster validation (§2.3b).
PLAYER_RANK{ship} base <= 1 is rewritten as 2 (loader floor), TRIAL_ID_{ship} == 1 returns TRIAL_RANK_{ship} instead (§2.3b).
DroneUsed{slot} negative is written back as 0 before use (§2.3).
design_decisions: A Godot user:// JSON document replaces Unity PlayerPrefs. Atomicity, migration, cloud sync and store durability are new design; the source contract proves none of them.
Getters here are pure. The source getters have side effects (StageTarget increments on read, TUTORIAL becomes 6); the slice does not reproduce them and records this as a design decision.
Unknown keys found in an existing save file are preserved and rewritten unchanged.
StarStageMaster{stage}_{mode} stores the best star count; StarCount is recomputed as the sum of saved stage stars instead of being incremented blindly.
